method: Random sample of 30 of the 163 matched real-money pairs (scripts/sample.mjs, seed 20260925, data snapshot 2026-09-25T12:36:58Z). Each pair was labeled against the rule texts in the snapshot: equivalent — the rules match in substance; caveats — they match except for rare edge cases or settlement timing; different — there is a plausible scenario in which the markets settle differently.
reviewer: Claude (AI assistant), not independently re-checked by a human
